portCalibration.sourceAlphaCorrection: Raw source keys are kept above as evidence; the following desktop calibration is intentionally distinct from Unity HDR compositing
portCalibration.coreWhite: 0.96 * (1 - smoothstep(0ms,22ms,age)); input births use event-time offset
portCalibration.ringRadiusMeaning: water and outer arc share the envelope; the second arc smoothly reaches 6.5 percent inward inset at 120ms
portCalibration.localGlow: Cached 384px water R/G weights, separate cached feathered birth flash and bounded ray alpha; ColorMatrix plus FillOpacityMask. Five cached 96px exterior shape halos.
portCalibration.coreBody: selected saturated water without white fill; separate original birth flash supplies white; initial tint mixes 6 percent white; edge RGB*.90,.95,1; early edge mix .70
portCalibration.fragmentAlpha: source three dip/recovery cycles; click floor .42, drag floor .10; final .75-1 life smooth fade
portCalibration.birthRadiusCorrection: .04 * exp(-ageSeconds/.055) added to normalized growth; shared by water and both rims
portCalibration.ringClipColorFix: straight white RGB=1; threshold clips alpha only; avoids RGB=alpha^2 before source-over
portCalibration.ringSecondPhase: first phase + 2 radians + .08*wrapped sampled phase difference; bounded overlapping arc separation
portCalibration.ringComposition: additive PLUS, brighter overlapping cyan arcs
portCalibration.clickFragmentExpansion: birth at shared newborn wave radius + (1.1+random*2.2*scatter)*scale; full wave-radius delta plus3-8px/s scaled local drift
portCalibration.ringSecondInset: .065 * smoothstep(0ms,120ms,age), radial scale applied to the second arc only
portCalibration.coreComposition: water SOURCE_OVER without white fill; original fixed-radius birth flash PLUS, exp(-age/.022)*(1-smoothstep(40ms,100ms,age)); subtract flash from the body alpha budget
portCalibration.linkedFragmentColor: chromatic HSL lightness +.04, clamp .67-.79, saturation *.86; low-chroma smooth blend toward L+.46*(1-L); exact black remains black
portCalibration.ringDirection: counterclockwise in screen coordinates; negative angular increment with the existing source velocity curve
portCalibration.ringDissolveField: all 9 source alpha rows, angular profile exponent .64; radial multiplier .35+.65*exp(-.5*((radius-mid)/(.4*bandWidth))^2)
portCalibration.birthFlash: born at maximum intensity, monotonic decay; cached 384px feathered mask with palette-colored fringe; no delayed rebrightening or rapid-click branch

fragmentWhite.flicker: three alpha dip/recovery cycles; RGB stays colored
